content: Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this medication and your specific health needs. Precautions: Before starting entecavir, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This medication may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. Entecavir may cause dizziness, and consuming alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring alertness until you are confident you can do so safely. Refrain from consuming alcoholic beverages, as alcohol can worsen liver conditions. To reduce the risk of transmitting hepatitis B to others, always use an effective barrier method, such as latex or polyurethane condoms or dental dams, during all sexual activities. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly necessary. It is not known whether entecavir prevents the transmission of hepatitis B from mother to baby. Additionally, it is unclear if this medication passes into breast milk. If you have HIV, breastfeeding may transmit the virus to your baby. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory Tests: Regular medical tests, such as liver function tests and viral load assessments, should be conducted while taking this medication to monitor its effects. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Keep the medication in its original packaging to protect it from light. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the medication is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most current details.
